_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit. All fields are optional — CLI flags override these values.

_field_help.dateFrom: Only include messages on/after this date. Format YYYY-MM-DD or null for no lower bound.
_field_help.dateTo: Only include messages on/before this date (inclusive). Format YYYY-MM-DD or null for no upper bound.
_field_help.chats: Array of chat names or phone numbers to include. Empty array = ALL chats.
_field_help.downloadMedia: true = download photos/voice/video/docs into media folder. false = text only.
_field_help.maxMessagesPerChat: 0 = fetch as many as WhatsApp Web exposes. Otherwise cap per chat.
_field_help.throttleMs: Delay between message-fetch operations to stay stable on large accounts.
_field_help.mediaConcurrency: How many media files to download in parallel.
